result.brief: 提出 Concat IDM：用离线轨迹中的动作标签从拼接潜状态预测动作，作为保持内在动力学的表征学习归纳偏置，提升视觉多样性下的潜空间规划成功率。
result.reason: Studies latent world model representation learning, showing action-predictability (inverse dynamics) as inductive bias preserving control-relevant dynamics in shared encoder; representation contribution, not just policy.
